params.1273: Harvest a crop of cabbages from a vegetable patch.
params.1274: To grow cabbages you will need three cabbage seeds. You can pickpocket these from Master Farmers (with sufficient Thieving), buy them, or play Vinesweeper for them.
params.1275: Head to a vegetable patch to plant them.
params.1276: Cabbages can be used to make a garden pie with the Cooking skill. They can be protected from disease by growing rosemary next to them.
